property_summary: A fresh pool's initialize always reverts with FeeRateTooHigh when the requested fee rate exceeds 5000 bps, leaving initialized false.
For any parameters with feeRate <= 5000, initialize() on a fresh pool succeeds, sets initialized to true, and stores the fee rate exactly.

For any token and token id, a fresh pool's flashFee equals the sum of its change-fee component (changeFee scaled by 10^14 for an ETH base token) and its protocol-fee component returned by flashFeeAndProtocolFee.
If a pool's merkle root is zero, sumWeightsAndValidateProof ignores the supplied weights and proof and returns 1e18 per token id.

property_summary: setFeeRate(v) reverts exactly when v exceeds 5000, and when it succeeds the pool's feeRate equals v.
After initializing an ETH-based pool with given reserves, price() always returns (virtualBaseTokenReserves * 10^18) / virtualNftReserves.
On a fresh (uninitialized) pool with zero merkle root, sumWeightsAndValidateProof returns tokenIds.length * 1e18 regardless of the weights supplied.
For a pool initialized with feeRate <= 5000, buyQuote returns a fee exactly equal to inputAmount * feeRate / 10000, hence never more than half of the input amount.
Buying zero NFT weight from an initialized pool always costs nothing: buyQuote(0) returns zero net input, zero pool fee and zero protocol fee, and never reverts, regardless of reserves or fee rates.
For an ETH-based pool, changeFeeQuote charges exactly inputAmount * changeFee * 10^14 / 10^18 as the pool fee (i.e. changeFee per whole NFT), independent of feeRate, reserves and merkle root.
For an ETH-based pool, changeFeeQuote on a single NFT weight of 1e18 returns a fee of exactly changeFee * 10^14 and a protocol fee of at most that fee.
